title: Document the tutor-mode Firestore/Functions surface in docs/api-contracts.md and fix the stale 'indexes.json is empty' claim

evidence.quote: **Live layout — `users/{uid}/...`** — every path is owner-gated by `isOwner(uid)`:
Firestore indexes | firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes | firestore.indexes.json (currently empty)

why: functions/src/index.ts exports 26 Cloud Functions today, not 4 — 22 of them (inviteTutor, acceptTutorInvite, revokeTutorGrant, tutorResetCompletion, tutorUpsertTrack, etc.) implement the entire tutor cross-user-access feature and are undocumented. firestore.rules has ~150 lines of top-level `tutor_grants`/`tutor_active_access` rules granting non-owner (tutor) reads on a child's records — directly at odds with api-contracts.md's characterization that 'every path is owner-gated'. firestore.indexes.json is not empty; it has 6 composite indexes, all for tutor_grants queries. This is the most privacy-sensitive feature in the codebase (cross-user access to a child's learning data, gated by SR-5) and the canonical API-contracts reference does not mention it exists.
recommendation: Add a Tutor Mode section to api-contracts.md covering tutor_grants/tutor_active_access collections, the tutor read carve-outs in firestore.rules, the 22 tutor* Cloud Functions, and the 6 composite indexes; fix the 'indexes.json is empty' line in both api-contracts.md and deployment-guide.md.
acceptance_criteria: api-contracts.md's Cloud Functions table lists all 26 exported functions from functions/src/index.ts (or explicitly groups the tutor_* ones with a count)
api-contracts.md documents tutor_grants and tutor_active_access as top-level collections
api-contracts.md and deployment-guide.md no longer claim firestore.indexes.json is empty
mergedFrom: Update docs/component-inventory.md and docs/api-contracts.md for the firebaseFirestoreProvider relocation to core/sync/
